blocks.text: You can create a playbook to group one or more response actions for a supported entity. You can manually trigger a playbook or use an automation rule to run the playbook automatically.

The entity type selected for the playbook and automation rule must be the same (e.g., a playbook created for the Alert entity type must be linked to an automation rule configured for the Alert entity type).

blocks.item: In the SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Agentic SOC or Identities.
In the left-side navigation, go to Automations > Playbooks.
The Playbooks page appears.
Click New Playbook.
See image.
The Create New Playbook page appears.
On the Create New Playbook page:
In the Details section:
Name: Enter a name for the playbook.
Active: Enable to activate the playbook.
Description: Enter a description for the playbook.
Entity Type: Select the entity type for which the playbook should run.
Alert: Select to run the playbook for an alert.
Incident: Select to run the playbook for an incident.
User: Select to run the playbook for a user.
Identity Finding: Select to run the playbook for an identity finding.
See image.
In the Permissions section:
Allow to Edit Playbook: Select the users who can edit the playbook.
Allow Manual Triggering: Select this checkbox to allow users to manually trigger the playbook, then complete the following steps:
Allow to Trigger Playbook: Select the users who can manually trigger the playbook.
Allow in Apps: Select the applications in which the playbook is enabled.
See image.
In the Actions section:
Click Add Action.
Select an action from the drop-down menu and provide the details (e.g., specify the recipient, subject, and message for an email).
Click Add Action to add more actions to the playbook.
See image.
Click Save.
The playbook is created and displayed on the My Playbooks page.

blocks.heading: Creating a Playbook from a Template

blocks.text: You can use a template from the template gallery to create a playbook.

blocks.item: On the Playbooks page, select the Template Gallery tab.
See image.
Click a template.
The Template Preview page appears.
Click Create from Template.
Review and modify the playbook information in the Details, Permissions, and Actions sections as required.
See image.
Click Save as New.
The playbook is created and displayed on the My Playbooks page.

blocks.heading: Creating a Playbook from a JSON File

blocks.text: You can create a playbook by importing a JSON file exported from an existing playbook. The JSON file contains the playbook name, description, entity type, actions, permissions, and status.
To create a playbook from a JSON file:

blocks.item: On the Playbooks page, click New Playbook.
The Create New Playbook page appears.
Click the More icon and select Import from JSON.
See image.
Select the JSON file that you want to import.
The playbook details are automatically populated from the JSON file (e.g., name and entity type).
If the imported playbook name already exists, an error message appears. Enter a new name to continue.
Review the imported playbook details.
Click Save.
The playbook is created and displayed on the My Playbooks page.
